title: Harmony Collection Capabilities (version 1)
description: Describes the Harmony transformation capabilities available for a given CMR collection, in version 1 of the collection capabilities JSON format.

conceptId.description: The CMR concept ID of the collection.

shortName.description: The CMR short name of the collection.

variableSubset.description: True if variable subsetting is supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

bboxSubset.description: True if bounding box subsetting is supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

shapeSubset.description: True if shape subsetting is supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

temporalSubset.description: True if temporal subsetting is supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

concatenate.description: True if concatenation is supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

reproject.description: True if reprojection is supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

outputFormats.description: The output format MIME types supported by any of the Harmony services for the collection.

services.description: The Harmony services applicable to the collection.

variables.description: The names of the variables associated with the collection.

capabilitiesVersion.description: The version identifier for the capabilities response format.

name.description: The name of the Harmony service.

serviceCapabilities.description: The capabilities configured for the service in the Harmony services configuration.
